policy.control_token_grammar: [CTRL:HHHH] with uppercase hexadecimal or an exact texts/textdefs.txt named token
policy.latin_only_detection: Latin present and no Han/kana in visible payload
policy.latin_span_tokenization: NFKC then contiguous Unicode letters whose names contain LATIN
policy.localized_decision_contract: exact current payload match and reviewed baseline span absent
policy.mojibake_detection: 2..4 scalar CP1252 runs that decode as distinct valid UTF-8
policy.replacement_c1_format_mojibake_policy: correction required; no approvals or broad exemptions
policy.unicode_confusable_detection: NFKC plus explicit enclosed-Latin and Greek/Cyrillic ASCII-lookalike skeletons
policy.unicode_script_policy: JA permits kana/Han and reviewed Latin/fullwidth spans; zh-Hans permits Han and reviewed Latin/fullwidth spans. Locale-prohibited kana/Bopomofo, Greek/Cyrillic lookalikes, enclosed alphanumerics, and Unicode math require exact target approvals. Replacement, C1, format, box drawing, private/surrogate/unassigned scalars are unconditionally rejected.
